title: Module 1: AI Safety and Alignment Foundations
description: Distinguish near-term safety from long-term alignment, recognize specification gaming and reward hacking, and identify five classes of intervention (better specification, interpretability, oversight, capability control, governance).
learning_objectives: Explain why goals expressed in code, reward functions, or natural language are lossy compressions of intent.
Identify specification gaming, reward hacking, Goodhart's law, and recommender feedback loops as expressions of the same underlying problem.
Distinguish capability from alignment and recognize why the two properties scale independently.
Match each safety/alignment intervention class to the failure mode it addresses, and explain why no single class is sufficient.
